thumbnail.pattern: the niche's air-crash covers show the airliner itself big at the moment it goes wrong with a few bold words; ours shows our 3D airliner rolling in the snowy cloud with its wing glowing red, two words on top

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Colgan Air's column shook at {fact3} knots.

params.place: the flight deck of the twin-propeller airliner at night, seen from behind the two pilots, snow streaking at the windshield

moments.what: the flight deck at night, snow streaking at the windshield, the date caption and the reconstruction tag; COLGAN AIR types on
the two control columns and yokes in front of the pilots, the airspeed box glowing amber
push in: both control columns rattle, the two STALL lights flash red, the airspeed box turns red
a STICK SHAKER stamp slams on over the windshield

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Near Buffalo, that shaking was the stall warning. It fires before a wing stalls. So what should a pilot do?

params.place: outside the airliner in the snowy night cloud on the approach, close beside its high wing

moments.what: the whole airliner in the falling snow, gear down, landing lights on; COLGAN AIR pinned on its fuselage, NEAR BUFFALO types on
STALL WARNING types on in amber
the camera pushes in along the fuselage to the high wing, still flying normally
WARNS BEFORE A STALL types on beside the wing
close on the wing in the snow, the propeller blurring beside it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Raise a wing's nose too steeply, and the air tears off its top. The trained answer: push the nose down.

params.place: the wing's cross-section on a night drafting grid, the oncoming air drawn as streamlines

moments.what: the wing section rotates nose-up into the dashed streamlines
the angle-of-attack arc draws on in amber, ANGLE OF ATTACK
push in: the flow over the top breaks into red swirls, the lift arrow collapses red
FLOW BREAKS AWAY types on over the swirls
a green arrow tips the nose down, PUSH: NOSE DOWN, the section rotates back
the streamlines hug the top again, the lift arrow grows back green

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The captain pulled his column back.

params.place: back on the flight deck, close on the captain's control column

moments.what: push in on the captain's rattling column, a green arrow above it and TRAINED: PUSH on a tag
the column slams back toward us, the green arrow is struck through in red, PULLED stamps on with a red flash
pull wide: the horizon drops out of the windshield as the nose rises, NOSE UP

params.place: right against the wing's top in the cloud, time slowed

moments.what: silence: the wing's top fills the frame glowing red, snow streaking over it, the wing shuddering
the sub-boom: the wing stalls and drops away, THE WING STALLS
wide: the airliner rolls in the cloud

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The nose rose, and the left wing dropped to {fact4} degrees. Then it whipped right, to {fact5}.

params.place: behind and beside the airliner as it rolls in the cloud over the dark town

moments.what: side-on in the snow, the airliner's nose pitches up, the wing glowing red
the left wing drops, the roll plate counts up in amber
the airliner whips over to the right, the second plate counts up in red
almost on its back, the nose drops into the cloud and the frame dims

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: In under half a minute, it came down on a house. All {fact6} people aboard were killed, and {fact7} on the ground.

place: high above the snowy streets of Clarence Center at night
down in the street, where fire engines and firefighters arrive

moments.what: far above the snowy town at night, UNDER HALF A MINUTE types on
an orange glow rises between the houses down the street, smoke drifting, CLARENCE CENTER
the toll plate for the people aboard lands
down into the street: fire engines' lights flash, firefighters with lamps walk toward the glow
the second plate, for the one person on the ground, lands below it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Startle or training: why did he pull? Full story on our channel. It started when

params.place: back on the flight deck in the snow, quiet again before the warning

moments.what: the quiet flight deck, snow streaking past, STARTLE types on
OR TRAINING? types on beside it
FULL STORY ON THE CHANNEL types on, the camera drifts toward the columns
the columns begin to rattle and the STALL lights flicker, back to the first frame
